public_fields.name: LetsAimIt
public_fields.description: LetsAimIt offers football, basketball and fitness activities for children aged 5–14 at Nambiar Bellezea and Nambiar Ellegenza in Bengaluru. Founded by youth football coach Dhiraj Mishra, the programme brings together warm-ups, skill practice and playing as a group. Sessions run twice a week and last 45–60 minutes. Parents can contact the team to discuss their child's age, experience and preferred sport, and confirm the group, timing, meeting point and community entry arrangements before attending. Available for enquiries every day, 9 am–9 pm IST.
